concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-google-pay-web-component]] — 2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Google Pay Web Component guide for v5+ Sessions/default versus direct payments, v6/v5 mounting, optional wallet settings, recurring route and TEST/LIVE gates; callback naming and snippets need version review.
warnings: The page refers to onAuthorize for Authorize Payments but its event table lists onAuthorized; do not treat them as the same callback.
The no-extra-config Sessions v5 example references googlePayConfiguration without defining it in that branch; v6 and older construction styles must remain distinct.
TEST wallet fixtures and isAvailable() do not prove live merchant production approval, successful 3DS, authorization, capture or settlement.
